huggingface.description: HuggingFace Hub access. Used to load Persius/imr-appeals (labelled benchmark) and Persius/hicric (KB corpus). Set HF_TOKEN in your environment if datasets are gated.

wandb.description: Weights and Biases experiment tracking. Log all LegalBERT fine-tuning runs, ablation experiments, and evaluation metrics. Required for reproducibility in thesis.

github.description: GitHub integration. Manage commits, branches, and issues for the agentic-rag-appeals repository. Use as the VS Code to Colab sync bridge.

filesystem.description: Local filesystem access scoped to the project directory. Enables reading/writing data files, CSV splits, FAISS index metadata, and evaluation results.

jupyter.description: Jupyter notebook execution. Run exploration notebooks (01_benchmark_exploration.ipynb, 02_kb_exploration.ipynb) directly. Useful for iterative data analysis in VS Code.

postgres.description: SQLite database for storing passage metadata, FAISS index lookup tables, and evaluation run results. Alternative to CSV-based metadata storage for larger-scale queries.

_project_notes.project: Agentic RAG Decision Support for Health Insurance Appeals

environment_split.vs_code_cpu: Weeks 1-4 — data prep, Agent 1, Agent 2 development

required_env_vars: HF_TOKEN — HuggingFace API token (free account sufficient for these datasets)
WANDB_API_KEY — Weights and Biases API key (free tier sufficient)
GITHUB_TOKEN — GitHub personal access token for repo management
setup_instructions: 1. Copy .env.example to .env and fill in your tokens
4. Run: python data/download_kb.py             (downloads hicric KB configs)
6. See SKILLS.md for subagent task descriptions and Week 1 detailed steps
